papers.title: Formation and Characterization of Ti-Al Intermetallic and Oxide Layers on Ti6Al4V as Interlayers for Hydroxyapatite Coatings
papers.abstract: This study explores a novel approach to enhance the surface properties of Ti-Al alloys for biomedical applications by creating a compositional gradient layer through aluminum deposition using Electrical Discharge Machining (EDM). The primary goal was to develop a metallurgically bonded intermetallic zone that supports strong adhesion and improved compatibility for subsequent hydroxyapatite (HA) deposition. Aluminum was deposited onto a Ti6Al4V substrate via EDM under controlled conditions, followed by thermal and thermochemical treatments to induce diffusion and intermetallic phase formation. Comprehensive analyses using optical and electron microscopy (SEM), energy-dispersive spectroscopy (EDS), and X-ray diffraction (XRD) revealed the formation of well-adhered layers composed of complex Ti-Al intermetallics such as TiAl2 and TiAl3, along with oxide phases including TiO2 and Al2O3. Thermal and thermochemical treatments further improved surface hardness, reaching up to 1057 HV, and influenced the diffusion behavior of aluminum, titanium, and vanadium. Adhesion tests confirmed that the untreated and thermochemically treated layers exhibited superior mechanical stability, while thermal treatment alone led to brittleness and delamination. These findings demonstrate that a properly engineered intermediate aluminide layer can significantly improve the performance of bioceramic coatings, particularly HA, by providing enhanced structural integrity and biocompatibility.

llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文涉及Ti6Al4V表面处理，但主要关注涂层附着力而非疲劳或力学性能，与后处理控制疲劳/力学性能的方向关联较弱。
llm.why_not_core: Does not address fatigue or mechanical performance (only hardness reported); focus is on coating adhesion for hydroxyapatite, not post-processing for mechanical property improvement.

summary_zh.motivation: 通过铝沉积和热处理在Ti6Al4V表面形成梯度层以增强羟基磷灰石涂层附着力。
summary_zh.method: 采用电火花加工沉积铝层并结合热/热化学处理形成钛铝金属间化合物与氧化物层。
summary_zh.result: 形成了结合良好的TiAl2和TiAl3相，表面硬度最高达1057 HV，未处理与热化学处理层力学稳定性最佳。
summary_zh.validation: 通过SEM、EDS、XRD及硬度测试和附着力试验验证层结构和力学性能。

summary_en.motivation: This study aims to improve surface properties of Ti6Al4V for biomedical applications by creating a compositional gradient intermetallic layer to enhance hydroxyapatite coating adhesion.
summary_en.method: Aluminum is deposited via electrical discharge machining (EDM) followed by thermal and thermochemical treatments to induce diffusion and formation of Ti-Al intermetallics and oxides.
summary_en.result: Well-adhered layers composed of TiAl2, TiAl3, TiO2, and Al2O3 are formed, with hardness reaching 1057 HV; untreated and thermochemically treated layers show superior mechanical stability.
summary_en.validation: Layer formation and properties are validated using SEM, EDS, XRD, hardness testing, and adhesion tests.
